query:
UPDATE agent_sessions
            SET executor = $2, agent_working_dir = $3, updated_at = datetime('now', 'subsec')
            WHERE id = $1
            RETURNING
                id as "id!: Uuid",
                task_attempt_id as "task_attempt_id!: Uuid",
                executor,
                agent_working_dir,
                created_at as "created_at!: DateTime<Utc>",
                updated_at as "updated_at!: DateTime<Utc>"
